actions.action: Inspect leaf undersides with magnifier or phone zoom
Wipe a speck with a wet cloth to test if residue
Look for honeydew or sooty mold on leaves below
Isolate the plant from other houseplants
Spray plant with water in sink or shower
Test insecticidal soap or neem oil on one leaf
Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil to all leaf surfaces every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Remove heavily infested leaves and dispose sealed
If specks wipe off, post close-up photo for another look

reason: The answer diagnoses whiteflies rather than aphids, but its main treatment (thorough neem oil/insecticidal soap spraying) matches the fix that worked, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
